hero.title: 维护修复应用
hero.summary: 面向排障和维护任务的具体应用，强调根因定位、最小修复范围、回归控制和运行稳定性。

taskTemplates.title: 定位并修复问题
taskTemplates.goal: 描述故障现象、复现路径和期望结果，让维护应用定位根因并做最小修复。
taskTemplates.description: 适合缺陷修复、稳定性问题和回归控制。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 定位根因并完成最小修复

hero.title: Maintenance & Repair
hero.summary: A focused application for diagnosis and maintenance. It emphasizes root-cause analysis, minimal repair scope, regression control, and runtime stability.

taskTemplates.title: Diagnose and fix an issue
taskTemplates.goal: Describe the failure, reproduction path, and expected result so the maintenance application can find the root cause and make the smallest repair.
taskTemplates.description: For bug fixes, stability issues, and regression control.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Find the root cause and complete the minimal repair
